title: Ginger Grain, Nelson Bay: builders clean for Total Fitouts Newcastle
excerpt: A two-day builders clean of approximately 150 m², with flexible scheduling and close coordination with Total Fitouts Newcastle ahead of client handover.
challenge: Total Fitouts Newcastle engaged Your Office Space to complete a builders clean at the new Ginger Grain premises in Nelson Bay ahead of its upcoming opening. The approximately 150 m² hospitality premises included customer-facing areas and a commercial kitchen.
solution: With a changing construction programme, our team stayed in regular contact with the project manager and adjusted its cleaning schedule as required. The builders clean was completed over two days in November 2026.
outcome: Total Fitouts Newcastle accepted the completed builders clean and was satisfied with the finished result.

sections.heading: The challenge: a changing construction programme
paragraphs: The cleaning schedule needed to remain flexible around the builder’s programme. Regular communication with the project manager helped coordinate attendance with the remaining activities on site.

sections.heading: The scope: preparing the premises for handover
paragraphs: The agreed builders-clean scope covered the following areas and tasks. Extraction-system cleaning was excluded.

sections.heading: Our approach: close contact and flexible scheduling
paragraphs: Your Office Space worked with the project manager to maintain regular contact and remain flexible where required. This allowed the two-day clean to be coordinated around the moving programme.

sections.heading: The outcome: accepted by the builder
paragraphs: Total Fitouts Newcastle accepted the completed clean and was satisfied with the finished result. The work helped prepare Ginger Grain’s premises for client handover.
The photographs below show the completed clean, including the customer area, service counter and commercial kitchen.

sections.heading: A project for a regular builder client
paragraphs: This Nelson Bay builders clean was undertaken for Total Fitouts Newcastle as a regular client. It does not represent an expansion of our regular office and commercial cleaning service area, which remains Newcastle CBD and Lake Macquarie.

closing.heading: Planning a builders clean?
paragraphs: Tell us about your project, location, cleaning scope and handover programme. We can discuss whether we can assist and confirm the inclusions, exclusions and scheduling requirements for your site.
